stem:
A block of modeling clay of mass *M* is attached to a string as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

A pellet travelling at speed *u* enters the block and causes the block to move through a vertical height *h*.

The experiment is repeated for different values of *M*.

It is suggested that *h* and *M* are related by the equation

$\frac{1}{h}=2g\left(\frac{M+Z}{uZ}\right)^2$

where *g* is the acceleration of free fall and *Z* is a constant.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted of $\sqrt{\frac{1}{h}}$ on the *y*-axis against *M* on the *x*-axis.

Determine expressions for the gradient and *y*-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *M* and *h* are given in Table 2.1.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of $\sqrt{\frac{1}{h}}$/cm⁻¹ᐟ² in Table 2.1.

Include the absolute uncertainties in $\sqrt{\frac{1}{h}}$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Plot a graph of $\sqrt{\frac{1}{h}}$/cm⁻¹ᐟ² against *M*/g.

Include error bars for $\sqrt{\frac{1}{h}}$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the *y*-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of *u* and *Z*. Include appropriate units.

Data: *g* = 981 cm s⁻²

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated. Determine the mass *M* that gives a value of *h* of 25.0 cm.

figures.caption: Fig. 2.1
figures.alt: A block hangs from a string attached to a support, with a pellet approaching from the right and a dashed path showing the block's swing through height h.

figures.caption: Table 2.1
figures.alt: A table with columns for M in grams, h in centimetres, and the values of √(1/h) in cm⁻¹ᐟ²; the first two columns contain six sets of values and the last column is blank.
A blank graph grid with √(1/h) in cm⁻¹ᐟ² on the vertical axis and M in grams on the horizontal axis.

problems: part b: numeric part needs answer {symbol, unit} (either may be null)
